name: kinetic-boolean
description: One cell: Lipniacki 2004 NF-kB (TelluriumProcess, pre-equilibrated, TNF_R stepped to 1 through parameters_in) -> NF-kB nuclear fraction f (the SBML's own rule) -> Calzone 2010 cell fate (MaBoSSProcess, all 31 nodes, NF-kB gated by Calzone's own logic). The Boolean NF-kB node switches at kappa per second; the death machinery runs on k_time.

r_tx.description: transcription-scale steps' ON rate (1/s), from Lipniacki

expressions.expr: IKKactive_IkB_NFKB + NFKB + IkB_NFKB + (1 / Kv) * NFKB_nuc + (1 / Kv) * IkB_NFKB_nuc
